_comment: Safe 50x50 monthly host-zone layouts. Version changes replace the active layout on deployment and return visitors to the entrance; old editions remain archived. Export with python/export_online_districts.py. A district may declare dormitory {x,y,w,h,door:{x}}: a fixed room above the entry area holding the six shared beds (Rose Court keeps its beds here instead of a Resting Hall).

npcs.name: Castle Greeter
npcs.line: Welcome to The Castle. The rooms change each month, but the passage back to Rose Court is always on the east wall.

npcs.name: Royal Housekeeper
npcs.line: The reading rooms and rose parlours are open to everyone. Take your time and make yourself comfortable.

npcs.name: Court Tailor
npcs.line: The court has a new arrangement every month. Proper shopping and the shared bank are through the hub's Market Hall.

npcs.name: Hall Steward
npcs.line: No battles in these halls. This is a place to meet your friends between adventures.

npcs.name: Pip, Palace Page
npcs.line: I've delivered this invitation twice already. The first time I found the right room, but the wrong tea party. A very good tea party, though.

npcs.name: Celia, Wandering Librarian
npcs.line: I'm collecting books people left in the parlours. If the bookmark is a biscuit, I assume they're coming back.

npcs.name: Orin, Music-Box Tuner
npcs.line: Hear that little tune? One of the music boxes is half a note flat. I keep following it, and somebody keeps winding a different one.

npcs.name: Fern, Rose Tender
npcs.line: The roses get a little turn in the light every afternoon. Sometimes I take the long way round. They deserve to see the castle too.

npcs.name: Market Host
npcs.line: Welcome to Market Square! Follow the broad paths to find the stalls, or head east to return to Lantern Court.

npcs.name: Travelling Trader
npcs.line: We rearrange the square on the first of every month. There is always somewhere new to meet.

npcs.name: Ribbon Seller
npcs.line: I'm displaying samples today. The hub's Market Hall has the merchants who can take your orders.

npcs.name: Tea Stall Host
npcs.line: Pull up beside a friend and enjoy the village bustle. There are no monsters to interrupt you here.

npcs.name: Bram, Bread Enthusiast
npcs.line: I'm comparing the smells from all the bread stalls. It's serious work. I may need a second lap before I reach a conclusion.

npcs.name: Tansy, Village Courier
npcs.line: A letter for the ribbon seller, a parcel for the tea stall, and a very firm instruction not to squash either. I like a manageable adventure.

npcs.name: Merri, Humming Busker
npcs.line: I'm trying out a tune with no sad verses. Hum along if you like; I haven't decided how the middle goes yet.

npcs.name: Wren, Window Shopper
npcs.line: I came for one spool of thread. So far I've found a lovely cup, three ribbons, and absolutely no thread.

npcs.name: Velvet Lounge Host
npcs.line: Welcome to the Red Light District. Enjoy the warm lights and a quiet chat. The east passage leads back to Clockwork Coliseum.

npcs.name: Evening Guide
npcs.line: Everyone gets to set their own pace here. Ask before joining someone's evening.

npcs.name: Night Market Regular
npcs.line: New streets, familiar faces. The neighbourhood changes its layout at the start of each month.

npcs.name: Night Porter
npcs.line: These streets are a safe place to gather. Leave the arena battles inside the Coliseum.

npcs.name: Ellis, Lamplighter
npcs.line: The lamps nearest the benches get checked twice. People linger there, and a good conversation shouldn't have to end just because the light does.

npcs.name: Vesper, Off-Duty Performer
npcs.line: My next set isn't for a while. I'm giving my feet a little walk before I ask them to dance again.

npcs.name: Nell, Night Florist
npcs.line: These flowers open after sunset. Late bloomers, all of us. There's no prize for having your best evening before supper.

npcs.name: Rowan, Pavement Poet
npcs.line: I've got a rhyme for lantern, almost. I'm walking until the next line arrives. At this rate it may be a rather long poem.
